reason: The submitted Pbcn TiO2-II model is sufficiently established. The trajectory instantiated and screened the available stoichiometric TiO2 polymorphs, independently indexed the orthorhombic Z=4 cell, used the observed extinction/peak pattern to distinguish Pbcn from brookite and other polymorphs, and refined all four independent positional parameters rather than submitting an unmaterialized prototype. The CIF is stoichiometric and fully occupied, with plausible octahedral Ti-O distances (1.88-2.12 A) and no element-ordering ambiguity. Although no comparable Rwp was supplied, the reported profile correlation is 0.99926 over 23-64.3 degrees, and an independent fixed-structure check reproduces the full 5-90 degree pattern with correlation 0.99884, including strong high-angle reflections outside the refinement interval. No materially different scientifically motivated realization remains likely to improve the candidate set.
